d:
Bihar men apradhiyon ke nishane par jvelri dukanen hain...jahan betiya men dinadhare hathiyarband apradhiyon ne sone-chandi ki dukan ko nishana banakar karoron ki lut ko anjam diya... vahin arriya men bhi choron ne pulis ko chunauti dete hue shagun jvelars se karib ek karor ke gahne aur nakdi ura die...jisse pulis ki suraksha vyavastha par bare saval khare ho gae hain...
